title: Historic Highlight Tour of Charleston
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
The Historic Highlight Tour of Charleston will show guests the most beautiful, historic and cultural places in Charleston. This includes the French Quarter neighborhood and Charleston's famous South of Broad neighborhood. Allow our knowledgable and easy going guides to take you back and time to see churches, cobblestone road, alleyways and mansions. 

The tour includes iconic locations such as Rainbow Row, the Battery, Pineapple Fountain, the Four Corners of Law the City Market and more! Join Chicora Tours for a fun and informative tour experience Questions on tours are always welcomed and encouraged!
